$comment: Free agency and trade rule values with no league-rules key yet (requested from G-10 via 'Research missing league rule values' and the integrator). Each was read directly in the CBA text at /mnt/project-files/nfl-rules/cba_2020.txt. marketRules() reads the league-rules file first and falls back to these rows; a test fails if both define a key with different values. Status is what the bible leaf gives, else 1 of 3 (the CBA text alone).

keys.source: CBA 2020 Art. 9 s.2(b)(i)(2)-(4): "110% of the player's prior year's Paragraph 5 Salary, whichever is greater"; bible C8.1.1 rule 2 (audit 3b, Verified)
CBA 2020 Art. 9 s.1(b)(i): "a one year Player Contract of at least 110% of either (a) his Prior Year Salary ... or (b) his Paragraph 5 Salary"; bible C8.2.1 rule 5 (audit 3d, 2 of 3)
CBA 2020 Art. 9 s.3(a): "within five days from the date it receives the Offer Sheet"; bible C8.1.1 rule 4 (audit 3c, Verified)
CBA 2020 Art. 9 s.3(b): "but not later than one day before the Draft (unless the parties agree otherwise)"
CBA 2020 Art. 9 s.2(j): compensation is due in the following year's draft if "the Offer Sheet is received by the Prior Club later than two days before that League Year's Draft"
CBA 2020 Art. 9 s.1(b)(i)-(ii) and s.2(f)(ii): "the Tuesday following the tenth week of the regular season, at 4:00pm New York time"; bible C8.2.1 rule 5 (2 of 3)
CBA 2020 Art. 9 s.3(e)(i): club-performance incentives likely to be earned "may not exceed 15% of the Salary in the Offer Sheet"
CBA 2020 Art. 9 s.3(h): a club that matches "may not trade that player to the Club that submitted the Offer Sheet for at least one calendar year, unless the player consents"
